Name: Hypno Valley
Author: Kryspur
Description:
[size=6][b]Hypno Valley
[/b][/size][size=6][b]
[/b][/size]
A whole new world of possibilities awaken for you as the traveling hypnotist Kris makes her way into the valley. Visit her shop east of the bookseller to learn the secret of the trade yourself and entrance the residents of Stardew Valley into doing your bidding.

[b][size=4][Features][/size][/b]
[i]*Please note this mod is a work-in-progress and not all of the following features are fully implemented at this time[/i]

[list]
[*]Entrance the residents of Stardew Valley with many hypnotic commands. Make them confess their love, lose their memories, become your loyal pet, and more
[*]Purchase and upgrade tools of the trade in order to more deeply hypnotize and more powerfully implant your commands into the villagers.
[*]Grow crops and craft technology to allow you to further tighten your grip on everyone's minds
[/list]

***This mod is currently a work-in-progress and not all features are fully implemented at this time. Please see the following information on what is currently implemented into the mod, and what will be added in the near future, before installing this mod for a more accurate representation of the current state of the mod.
Any and all feedback is welcome as this mod continues through development towards the final release.

[b][size=4][In the latest version][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]1 crop and 1 artisan good available for trade at Kris's shop.
[*]5 tools available for purchase at the shop.
[*]1 technology blueprint available to purchase at the shop.
[*]6 commands available when using a hypnotic tool on a villager
[*]Trances can only be applied to the vanilla date-able villagers.
[/list]
[b][size=4][Installation Instructions][/size][/b]
Extract the .zip file and move both the 「HypnoValley」 and 「[CP] HypnoValley」folders into your game's mod folder. Please see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]this wiki page[/url]﻿ for help in locating your game's mod folder.
[b][size=4]
[Compatibility]
[/size][/b]This mod should be compatible with most other mods. If any conflicts arise, feel free to let me know and I will update this page as they are found.
Currently not compatible with Stardew Valley on mobile. I am working on a fix, but it will likely not be released until after the 1.6 update is released for mobile.
